note: Cordon's eight sources, all official. OSAC is excluded: its terms bar publishing or harvesting without authorization.

sources.name: US Department of State travel advisories (JSON)
sources.licence: US public domain (seals and logos restricted)

sources.name: US embassy alert RSS feeds (per post)
EASA Conflict Zone Information Bulletins (CSV export)
NGA Maritime Safety Information navigational warnings in force (daily text lists; the JSON API when it answers with current data)
FAA National Airspace System status, airport events (the JSON behind nasstatus.faa.gov)
sources.licence: US Government work, not subject to US copyright (17 U.S.C. 105); the FAA states no licence on nasstatus

sources.name: UK FCDO foreign travel advice (GOV.UK Content API: index and country pages)
FAA temporary flight restrictions (tfr.faa.gov list JSON and detail XML)
sources.licence: US Government work, not subject to US copyright (17 U.S.C. 105); the FAA states no licence on the TFR site

sources.name: Government of Canada travel advice and advisories (open.canada.ca dataset bef2ebb3-ca9a-485f-aaff-5dc36eb89426, data.international.gc.ca JSON index)
Overseas Security Advisory Council reports
sources.licence: Terms bar publishing or harvesting without authorization

state-travel-advisories.descriptor: Official advisories, 218 entries, level 1-4 with full text

us-embassy-alerts.descriptor: Per-post WordPress RSS; the type is in the title prefix

easa-czib.descriptor: Bulletin table with number, revision, valid-until and status

faa-nas-status.descriptor: Ground stops, ground delay programs and airport closures in effect, with UTC times and airport coordinates; keyless, checked live 13 Nov 2026

uk-fcdo-travel-advice.descriptor: 226 countries with the FCDO's advise-against statements and its own note of each update; keyless, checked live 14 Nov 2026

faa-tfr.descriptor: Temporary flight restrictions with NOTAM text, UTC times and the FAA's own outline; keyless, checked live 14 Nov 2026

gac-travel-advisories.descriptor: 230 places with Canada's advisory level 0-3, regional advisories and its own note of each update, in one file; keyless, checked live 14 Nov 2026
